summary: DHT Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching its press release for Q1 2026 results. The release reports adjusted EBITDA of $133.3M, net profit of $164.5M ($1.02 EPS), and a $0.64 dividend. It details the sale of two VLCCs (DHT Europe and DHT China) for $101.6M aggregate consideration, generating a $60M gain, and delivery of three newbuilds with $158.3M in installments. The filing is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or restructuring event is disclosed.
